$comment: VALID — one half of the presence-divergence pair (the §5.7 fixture from the A2A thread). This plan OMITS the step's optional maxSpendEur; its twin, presence-divergence-explicit-default.json, sets it explicitly to 0 — the documented effective default (a step with no declared spend spends nothing against the mandate). Same validator semantics, different authored bytes: the two canonical-bytes keys MUST differ, because omitted-stays-omitted and defaults are never materialized into the canonical form.
